reviews.text: Friendly and very professional staff, I recommend them.

Carly is the best groomer I've ever tried; she genuinely loves my dog ​​Myco, and the feeling is mutual. I'm so happy to have found my gem to groom my Lagotto Romagnolo properly, according to the breed standard cut.

I was very happy with my cat's grooming and the quick service. It was fast and straightforward. The only downside was that we were asked to leave and come back in 30 minutes. I've never experienced this type of service where the customer is told they can't just sit and wait.

Incredible!!!! 100%..A thousand stars!!!
Hats off to Caroline, a true expert with cats.

Thank you so much.
Joelle the groomer did my dog ​​Athena in the evening and wow, she smelled amazing and her fur was so soft! I highly recommend her.

Very disappointing experience – Confusing instructions, lack of follow-up, and disrespectful attitude

I am leaving this review due to poor communication, contradictory instructions on the website, and a complete lack of professionalism.

I made an appointment on July 16th and had to wait more than two weeks for the session. The instructions on the website are confusing:

"If you would like a bath for your first visit with your cat, please choose 'Bath Initiation.' This allows us to get to know and meet your feline for the first time!"

Then, just below:

"For a first appointment with us, please do not choose the bath."

By reading the first sentence, any reasonable client would understand that this refers to a gentle or adapted first bath for a new cat. After all that waiting and travel time to get there with my pet, my cat wasn't bathed at all! The session consisted solely of letting him hear the sound of water and the dryer, and feeling the heat. Calling this service "Bath Training" when no bath is actually performed is very misleading. It should be clearly titled "Assessment/Desensitization Session without Bathing."

To top it all off, the customer service was sorely lacking. I had left a voicemail in advance with my full contact information to ask if there was any possibility of coming earlier in case of a cancellation: no return call, not even to tell me there were no openings or to clarify the nature of the appointment.

Finally, the staff's attitude at the salon was extremely immature. Looking down for a moment and then up again, I caught the owner exchanging a mocking smile at my expense with a teenage girl sitting at reception in her pajamas (who appeared to be her daughter?). Openly mocking a customer confused by a lack of clarity on their own website is completely unacceptable.

Making people wait, requiring them to travel for a simple initial consultation without even washing their clothes, ignoring phone messages, and displaying such a lack of courtesy is very disappointing. I do not recommend this establishment.
Our "spa" for several years now for our 2 Golden Retrievers. They are extraordinary!

I take my two dogs with special needs to this grooming salon and I have nothing but praise for them. Sandra and Carlie are true dog lovers. They are incredibly attentive and very sensitive to the specific needs and comfort of the animals entrusted to their care. They are gentle and loving, which greatly contributes to making grooming a pleasant experience. A big thank you, Sandra!
My dog, Super Jedi, adores Carly; she's adorable with animals and, above all, she does a fantastic job grooming.
Very rude and unprofessional. Groomer couldn’t even communicate with me properly either in english or in french. To be avoided
I've had my cats shaved here several times and I'm very satisfied. Caroline is efficient and friendly, I highly recommend her services!

Nothing but praise for Spa Poilu! Our little dog Roxy clearly enjoyed her grooming session. We are 100% satisfied and have already booked our next appointment. I will recommend them to anyone who will listen! Thank you!
A welcoming homely environment and very kind staff, both on the phone and in person.

Excellent first experience for my one-year-old miniature Australian Shepherd.

Despite being very timid by nature, the team at the animal shelter did an amazing job; we'll definitely be back!
It was worth the wait!
See you in a few months! :)
I find it a bit expensive and I don't really like the cut on my dog.
I wouldn't entrust my cats to anyone else!

A very disappointing experience.

I had an appointment for my very anxious cat, whom I had medicated to help him tolerate the grooming. I arrived early, but my first Uber driver canceled when they saw I had a pet. So I had to order a special pet Uber (something I was completely unaware of), which took over 20 minutes to arrive.

I immediately called to let them know I would be 10 to 15 minutes late. I was told that if I was more than 15 minutes late, the cat wouldn't be accepted, even though I had clearly explained the circumstances and my pet's sensitivity.

I arrived at exactly 2:45 PM for a 2:30 PM appointment, and despite my explanations, my good faith, and even offering to shorten the grooming session, I was categorically refused service. I understand that a schedule needs to be respected, but a minimum of empathy, understanding, and flexibility would have been the least they could do, especially when dealing with anxious animals for whom every trip is an ordeal.

I do not recommend this salon for people with pets with special needs. There is clearly a lack of listening and compassion.
